q: What makes a metric a KPI?
options: It is tied to a key goal and has a target
why: KPIs are the few metrics directly linked to goals, with targets.

q: Auto-match rises from 70% to 85%. How should you describe the change?
options: An increase of 15 percentage points (about 21% relative)
why: 85 − 70 = 15 points; 15 ÷ 70 ≈ 21% relative increase.

q: How is SLA compliance calculated?
options: Items closed within SLA ÷ items closed × 100
why: SLA compliance is the share of items meeting the agreed time.

q: What does an OKR consist of?
options: An objective plus measurable key results
why: OKRs pair an inspiring objective with 2–5 measurable key results.

q: Defects found after release ÷ total defects × 100 measures…
why: Defect leakage shows how many defects escaped testing.

q: Which KPI is SMART?
options: Raise monthly APAC auto-match from 70% to 90% by 31 December
why: It is specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound.

q: Which is a leading indicator for month-end aged breaks?
options: Number of items unmatched for more than 3 days today
why: Leading indicators predict outcomes and can be acted on now.

q: What does Goodhart's law warn about?
options: When a measure becomes a target, people may game it
why: Optimizing one number can distort behavior. Pair KPIs to balance it.

q: Two teams report different turnaround times for the same process. What best prevents this?
options: A KPI definition sheet with formula, source and owner
why: Precise, shared definitions ensure consistent calculation.

q: Analysts are measured only on items closed and leave hard items aging. What is the best fix?
options: Pair the volume KPI with an aging or quality KPI
why: Balanced KPIs reduce gaming.

q: Where should the most important KPI be placed on a dashboard?
why: Readers scan from top left in a Z or F pattern.

q: Which display gives the most useful context?
why: Comparisons to target and trend make a number meaningful.

q: Why shouldn't a dashboard rely on color alone to show status?
options: Color-blind users may not see the difference
why: Add icons, labels or patterns so status is accessible.

q: A team needs to know which exceptions require action today. Which dashboard type fits?
why: Operational dashboards show current work needing action.

q: Roughly how many KPIs should a single dashboard page show?
why: Too many KPIs become noise.

q: Which chart best shows how a value changes over 12 months?
why: Line charts show trends over time.

q: Which chart best shows whether two numeric variables are related?
why: Scatter plots reveal relationships between two measures.

q: Why should bar chart axes start at zero?
why: Bar length represents value, so cutting the axis misleads.

q: When is a pie chart acceptable?
options: Showing parts of a whole with only a few slices
Showing a relationship between two variables
why: Pies work only for a few parts; people compare angles poorly.

q: Which chart shows how you got from opening balance to closing balance step by step?
why: Waterfall charts show additions and subtractions between two totals.

q: What is DAX?
options: The formula language for Power BI measures
why: DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) is used for calculations in Power BI.

q: In a star schema, the central table of transactions is called the…
why: Facts hold measurable events; dimensions describe them (date, account, country).

q: Each country manager should see only their country's data in the same report. Which feature does this?
why: RLS restricts which rows each user can see.

q: In Tableau, 'country' is a ___ and 'amount' is a ___.
why: Dimensions are categories; measures are numbers to aggregate.

q: Why schedule a data refresh for a published dashboard?
options: So it updates automatically without manual work
why: Automated refresh keeps data current and removes manual effort.

q: The same ad-hoc question keeps arriving each week. What is the best response?
options: Build a self-service dashboard that answers it
why: Repeated questions are a signal to automate and enable self-service.

q: What is the first step in reducing ad-hoc reporting requests?
options: Log the requests to find recurring themes
why: Data about the requests shows what to automate.

q: Which belongs in a report specification?
options: Purpose, audience, KPIs, data sources, refresh and access
why: A spec defines what the report must do before it is built.

q: Self-service dashboards reduce decision turnaround mainly because…
options: Leaders can get trusted data immediately instead of waiting for custom reports
why: Fast access to reliable data speeds up decisions.

q: Which chart title follows data-storytelling best practice?
why: An insight title tells the reader the conclusion.

q: What should come right after the context in a data story?
options: The key insight in one sentence
why: Lead with the insight, then show evidence.

q: Two metrics rise together. What can you conclude?
options: They are correlated; that alone doesn't prove one causes the other
why: Correlation is not causation.

q: How should you end a data presentation to leaders?
options: With a clear recommendation and its expected impact
why: Decision makers need a clear 'so what' and next step.
